_not: The intro tour and the README intro section are generated from THIS file (python/hyprsetup/intro.py). To add, reorder or reword pages, edit only this file, then run: python3 tools/intro-readme.py. 'media' is a path relative to this folder (.gif, .png, .webm, .mp4); if the file is missing, the app shows a placeholder box. A line starting with '- ' is a bullet, a line starting with '### ' is a subheading; [text](url) is a link. A page with 'credits': true gets the list of credits for the bundled themes appended, generated from the manifests. A page with 'draft': true still has draft text.

pages.title: What is Souprland?
body: An installer that sets up a Hyprland desktop from scratch, and a settings app that takes over after installation.
- Theme, bar, terminal, launcher, keybinds: all from this window, applied instantly.
- Ready-made desktops install in one click and can be rolled back.
- Your keybinds stay the same on every theme.

pages.title: This Project Is Made With AI And Can Be Buggy As Hell
body: Sloprland (Souprland) is basically a script that controls Hyprland with a GUI.
- make your own with the setup wizard,
- or mix dotfiles together with Soup Maker.
If you see any bug (and you probably will), please open an issue on GitHub. I'll do my best to fix it.

pages.title: No bloat
body: By default you only get what a desktop needs. No AUR, no extras.
Want more? You choose it, nothing gets installed behind your back.
The repo is a bit big (~100 MB) because of the themes and wallpapers inside, but they just sit there until you use them.

pages.title: Security
body: There are dotfiles using AUR packages, and some features also need AUR. It is up to you to choose whether to use them or not. All settings and dotfiles that use AUR can be seen in the GUI.
As always with AUR, review PKGBUILDs before installing.
Some dotfiles include configs and scripts from other authors. So review them before use.
